spans.s:
Bodha is the name of a Ṛṣi in the Mantra Pāṭha.^1 He is
mentioned with Pratibodha in the Atharvaveda,^2 but Whitney^3
thinks that in the second passage, at least, the word is an
ordinary noun meaning ‘the wakeful one.’
1) ii. 16, 14. Cf. Winternitz, Mantra-
pāṭha, xiv.
2) v. 30, 10; viii. 1, 13.
3) Translation of the Atharvaveda, 474.
